title: Parallel Data Object Creation: Scalable Metadata Management in Parallel I/O Library
problem: High-level I/O libraries (PnetCDF, HDF5) require collective metadata consistency checks during parallel data object creation; cost scales with metadata volume and process count
motivation: Large-scale scientific applications create massive numbers of objects; reducing metadata creation overhead could improve I/O scalability and overall application performance
method: New file header format using partitioned metadata blocks enabling independent data object creation; reduces consistency check overhead through distributed metadata layout
key_novelty: First to enable independent (non-collective) data object creation in parallel I/O libraries via partitioned metadata blocks
contributions: Partitioned metadata block format enabling independent creation
196x improvement in object creation time on 4096 MPI processes (5.6M objects)
limitations: Limited to new file format; backward compatibility issues; evaluation on specific parallel filesystem; metadata overhead not fully quantified
